TaskDescription: Approach-avoidance decision game (neurogame.ucsf.edu): per trial a reward offer (treasures) and a punishment offer (bombs); approach or avoid by button press within 6 s.
DerivativeDescription: Authors' high-frequency activity (70-150 Hz), aligned to decision / button press (README: trigger 2 = align to decision (button press); code Fig_2.m 'time from decision'); time zero at sample 5000 of each 12000-sample trial (-4.999 to +7.000 s). Trials back-to-back; values unchanged.
